title: Effects of microplastics and nanoplastics on the brain and behavior: Evidence from rodent and human studies
title_zh: 微塑料与纳米塑料对大脑与行为的影响：来自啮齿类和人类研究的证据
abstract: Microplastics (MPs) and nanoplastics (NPs) pose serious environmental and health risks and have made plastic pollution a major concern worldwide. They have been detected in terrestrial and aquatic species, including humans, and have been linked to increased risks of cardiovascular, respiratory and metabolic diseases. However, a critical question remains regarding whether plastic pollution also affects brain function and behavior. This review summarizes the current state of knowledge on the neurotoxic effects of MPs and NPs (MNPs) in the brain and their impact on behavior in both humans and rodents. We analyzed recent studies across multiple experimental approaches, including in vitro assays, animal models, human biomonitoring, and emerging technologies (i.e., brain organoids) to provide a comprehensive overview of MNP-induced effects. Findings are organized and discussed in terms of their influence on behavior, brain neurotransmission and function, and mechanistic pathways underlying neurotoxicity. We conclude that clarifying how MNPs affect neural systems and behavior, and exploring strategies to prevent or reverse their neurotoxic effects, will be crucial for safeguarding brain health in an increasingly plastic-contaminated world.
abstract_zh: 微塑料（MPs）和纳米塑料（NPs）对环境和健康构成严重风险，使塑料污染成为全球主要关注点。它们已在陆地和水生物种（包括人类）中被检测到，并与心血管、呼吸和代谢疾病风险增加相关。然而，关于塑料污染是否也影响大脑功能和行为的关键问题仍未解答。本综述总结了MPs和NPs（MNPs）在大脑中的神经毒性及其对人类和啮齿类动物行为影响的最新研究进展。我们分析了多种实验方法的最新研究，包括体外检测、动物模型、人类生物监测以及新兴技术（如大脑类器官），以提供MNP诱导效应的全面概览。研究结果按其对行为、大脑神经递质与功能以及神经毒性机制的影响进行组织和讨论。我们得出结论，阐明MNPs如何影响神经系统和行为，并探索预防或逆转其神经毒性效应的策略，对于在日益受塑料污染影响的世界中保障大脑健康至关重要。
